§6Fullerene Solution§f

§aThe starting fluid for fullerene. Corrosive, polluting, and annoying to produce in bulk.§f

§bFullerene Solution§f is a corrosive, polluting liquid (NFPA 3/3/3) used in the §bSILEX§f process to produce §bCrystalline Fullerite§f. You need high-performance solvent and fine soot, both late mid-game products.

§6Make It§f (Industrial Mixer):
§b•§f §e500 mB§f High-Performance Solvent
§b•§f 1 Fine Soot
§b•§f Output: §e250 mB§f Fullerene Solution

That is a §e2:1§f input-to-output ratio. Not great.

§6The Full Chain§f:
§b•§f Industrial Smokestack or Pyrolysis Oven -> Fine Soot
§b•§f Mixer: HPS + Fine Soot -> Fullerene Solution
§b•§f SILEX with BiSmUTh laser crystal -> Fullerene at 100% efficiency

§ePS:§f Automate fine soot production early. High-performance solvent comes from the RBMK irradiation channel or the industrial mixer. You need fullerenes for the ICF reactor and FEnSU.
